memory.heading: Memory
memory.empty: No memory files yet. CC writes auto-memory to <dir/> after sessions; project CLAUDE.md is created when you write one.
memory.gitignoreHint: ⚠ <gi/> doesn't cover <slj/> — this override could be committed by accident.
memory.openWithTitle: Open this file in an external editor

permission.breakerToast: Auto-revert for this project was paused after {{n}} consecutive failures. The bypass grant is still active — revert it manually, then check the project's settings file.
permission.grantStickyToast: Bypass granted — stays until you revert.
permission.revertedToast: Reverted to the prior permission mode.
permission.heading: Permissions
permission.noData: No permission data for this project.
permission.byHand: This project is in bypassPermissions from your own settings ({{source}}) — not a Claudepot grant. Edit that file directly to change it.
permission.grantIntro: Grant <b1>bypassPermissions</b1> for this project. Time-boxed grants auto-revert when the timer ends; the <b2>Never</b2> preset is a sticky grant — Claudepot won't auto-revert, you remove it with the Revert button when you're done.

env.heading: Environment files
env.emptyHint: No <envfiles/> files in this project. Add a key below to create one.
env.deleteBody: This removes from entirely. To keep the value but disable it, use Comment out instead.

move.title: Move session
move.explain: From <from/> to the target you pick. Every transcript line's <cwd/> is rewritten so <resume/> opens the new project. History entries keyed by this sessionId follow; pre-sessionId entries stay behind.
move.noTargets: No live project targets — pick Other…
move.forceLive: Force past the live-session mtime guard
move.forceLiveDesc: — use only if CC isn't writing to this session.
move.forceConflictDesc: — will silently orphan the conflict copy.
move.cleanupSource: Remove source project dir if it's empty after the move
move.cleanupSourceDesc: — tidy up the husk when this was the last session here.

rename.title: Rename project
rename.caseHint: Different case = case-only rename (handled via two-step on case-insensitive disks).
rename.collisionOverwriteDesc: — replace files at target with source
rename.stateOnlyDesc: — update CC state, don't move the source directory
rename.forceDesc: — skip live-session detection. If CC is running against this project, its session files can be corrupted.
rename.ignorePendingDesc: — run even if a prior rename left a journal behind. Resolve pending journals first via Repair unless you know why this one is safe.
rename.previewIdle: Enter a new path to preview.
rename.approxNote: Preview is approximate. Live-session and pending-journal checks happen at apply time.
rename.resultCcRenamed_one: CC project dir renamed; {{modified}} of {{count}} jsonl file rewritten.
rename.resultCcRenamed_other: CC project dir renamed; {{modified}} of {{count}} jsonl files rewritten.
rename.resultPreserved: Pre-existing data preserved at <p/>. Retained 30 days.

remove.removedToast: Removed {{slug}}. Restore via project trash if needed.
remove.configOnlyToast: Removed config entries for {{slug}} (no session directory existed).
remove.liveBlocked: Live CC session running — close it first.
remove.title: Remove project
remove.noSessionDir: No session directory — config entries only.
remove.trashBody: Lives in <dir/> for 30 days. Restore via <cmd/>.
remove.noTrashBody: No session directory exists, so nothing moves to the trash. A snapshot of the stripped entries is kept in <dir/> (under <env/> if set).
remove.confirmAria: Type project slug to confirm removal

export.passphraseRequired: Encryption requires a passphrase (or untick Encrypt).
export.title: Export project
export.intro: Bundle the CC state for <cwd/> into a portable file. Credentials never travel.
export.optGlobal: Global content (CLAUDE.md, agents/, skills/, scrubbed settings, plugin registry)
export.optWorktree: Worktree (project's <dir/> dir + CLAUDE.md; local settings excluded)
export.optState: Claudepot state (account stubs only — no credentials)

import.title: Import bundle
import.flagsLine: Flags: global={{global}} · worktree={{worktree}} · live={{live}} · state={{state}} · enc={{enc}} · sig={{sig}}
import.acceptHooks: Accept all bundled hooks (default: write <f/> for review)

maint.cleanDesc: Remove CC project directories whose source folder no longer exists. Unreachable projects (unmounted volumes) are never auto-cleaned.
maint.previewTitle: Preview which orphan projects would be removed

artifacts.heading: Clean Recovery Artifacts
artifacts.desc: From renames you abandoned. CC isn't using these — safe to delete.
artifacts.confirmNote: Only files linked to an abandoned rename are affected. Recovery snapshots from successful or in-progress renames are left alone.

gc.heading: Garbage-collect old repair data
gc.desc: Remove abandoned rename journals and recovery snapshots older than the threshold. Preview first — the execute step is irreversible.

clean.title: Clean project data
clean.errorHint: If pending rename journals are blocking, resolve them in the Repair view first.
clean.cantCancelTitle: Can't cancel mid-run — the backend is holding the clean lock
clean.nothingHint: Every CC project dir maps to a source path that exists. Good.
clean.unreachableNote_one: <n>{{count}}</n> project with unreachable source paths will be left alone (drive unmounted or permission denied).
clean.unreachableNote_other: <n>{{count}}</n> projects with unreachable source paths will be left alone (drive unmounted or permission denied).
clean.disclaimer: Also prunes matching entries in <cj/> and <hj/>. Recovery snapshots are written before anything is deleted.
clean.protectedNote_one: <n>{{count}}</n> of these is on your protected list — its CC artifact directory will be removed, but <cj/> and <hj/> entries for that path will be preserved.
clean.protectedNote_other: <n>{{count}}</n> of these are on your protected list — its CC artifact directory will be removed, but <cj/> and <hj/> entries for that path will be preserved.
clean.skippedLive_one: <n>{{count}}</n> project skipped because a live Claude Code session was detected. Quit the session and re-run.
clean.skippedLive_other: <n>{{count}}</n> projects skipped because a live Claude Code session was detected. Quit the session and re-run.
clean.preservedProtected_one: Preserved sibling state for {{count}} protected path (CC artifact dir still removed)
clean.preservedProtected_other: Preserved sibling state for {{count}} protected paths (CC artifact dirs still removed)
clean.snapshotsHint: Saved before anything was deleted. Copy a path and open it with a JSON viewer to restore.

orphans.hint: Their original cwd no longer exists. Adopt them into a live project to keep them resumable.

adopt.title: Adopt orphaned projects
adopt.intro: Each orphan's original cwd no longer exists. <adopt>Adopt</adopt> to keep the history — choose a live target cwd and every session file is rewritten so <resume/> will cd into the new target. <remove>Remove</remove> to forget the orphan entirely — the slug dir is moved to the Trash and can be restored from there if you change your mind.
adopt.removeTitle: Move this orphan's slug dir to the Trash
adopt.confirmBody_one: {{count}} session · {{size}} will be moved to the Trash. You can restore from Trash if you change your mind.
adopt.confirmBody_other: {{count}} sessions · {{size}} will be moved to the Trash. You can restore from Trash if you change your mind.

repair.lockBrokenToast: Lock broken — prior owner PID {{pid}} on {{host}}. Audit saved.
repair.heading: Repair
repair.breakLockBody: Force-breaks the lock file for this journal and writes an audit record. The prior owner (if still alive) will fail on its next write.
repair.breakLockNote: Safe when the journal is stale (≥24 h). Don't break a running lock — that can corrupt in-flight state.
repair.breakLockBtnTitle: Force-break the stale lock file so resume can proceed
repair.resumeBody: Re-runs the move pipeline. Phases are idempotent.
repair.abandonBody: Writes a <f/> sidecar. Future runs will no longer nag about this journal.
repair.abandonNote: Audit trail is preserved; the journal itself is kept on disk.

templates.localOnlyNotice: This template runs only on a local route, but you don’t have one configured.
templates.sendsData: Sends data to your selected route.
